notes.title: Balance Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750880/f019c49c3e1606b914f96006ac3bfd1b4ec752c1.png[/img]

Hi Everyone, made a quick balance update:

- Added a cooldown timer for the explosion
- Made the explosion more powerful to make up for the cooldown
- Reduced the ramp up speed of gem spawn for a smoother game experience

More updates will be coming soon, stay tuned!

notes.title: Gameplay Overhaul
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750880/f019c49c3e1606b914f96006ac3bfd1b4ec752c1.png[/img]

Hi Everyone, sorry for the late update, life's been hectic and couldn't put in the time until recently.

This update brings an overhaul of the core gameplay, bringing a more engaging and fun experience!

Instead of dropping gems yourself, they now fall from the skies at a steady rate, increasing as the game goes on for longer, do your best to push the gems off the Arena to score points!

If any gems touch the center of the Arena, you will take damage, take too much damage and your run will be over!

I hope this version of the game is more enjoyable for ya'll, have fun!
